title: Alexey Filenkov
teaser: The visit card. Everything else is one click down a branch.

title: About this project
teaser: This site is one of the projects on the map. What it runs on, and why it is a tree instead of one long page.

title: Architecture
teaser: The live service map, box by box: TLS at the edge, the gateway, the product hosts, and the shared data plane under them.

title: Rejected cache
teaser: Redis on auth_network. Rejected tokens by jti and by user, OAuth CSRF state, IP rate-limit counters, and the auth_session → user map.

title: Auth Gateway
teaser: Go, :8083. The single place identity is decided: YAML host/path routing, access-JWT check, incoming X-Auth-* stripped and its own injected.

title: Caddy HTTPS
teaser: The only box on the external network. Terminates TLS with Let’s Encrypt on :80/:443 and hands every host to the gateway — it decides nothing.

title: Common Postgres & Redis
teaser: One Postgres and one Redis on common_network, shared by the product services. Each keeps its own schema; none of them keeps a session.

title: Hermes
teaser: Agent workspace on its own host, hermes.filenkov.store, behind the same Auth-Service JWT rather than a second password. Talks to MLflow and LiteLLM.

title: Hub (filenkov.store)
teaser: This page. A static Vite container on :80 behind the gateway: /auth/session, /auth/login, /auth/logout and /admin are answered by the edge itself, and the rest of the tree is static files. Only the gateway is published.

title: Chat
teaser: llm.filenkov.store → llama.cpp (container qwen38) on :4001, admins only. LiteLLM on :4000 stays internal behind /api/chat. Identity headers at the edge, no token downstream.

title: Common MinIO S3
teaser: Shared object store on :9000 — home_storage buckets, MLflow artifacts, and service backups.

title: MLflow
teaser: Experiment tracking on :5000, reached with client-certificate validation rather than the browser cookie. Artifacts to MinIO, metadata to the shared Postgres.

title: Prometheus & Grafana
teaser: observability_network. Prometheus scrapes the badged services — gateway, storage, Hermes, User-Service — and Grafana reads Prometheus. Nothing scrapes from outside.

title: Storage
teaser: storage.filenkov.store: a Python app on :8000 behind its own SPA. Gets X-User-Id and X-Storage-Role from the gateway, blobs on the shared MinIO.

title: User-Service
teaser: The directory of people on user_network — UUID, google_sub, username, global and per-service roles — with its own Postgres and Redis. Never sees a JWT.

title: Owl art
teaser: The owl is the site mascot: four moods, three clips, one tab icon. Every drawing in one place.

title: Site stack
teaser: React and Vite in a static nginx container, behind a Go gateway that routes by YAML and injects identity.
